te_blocked_fold.notes: te_global / te_enc in the blocked lane-tree order BLT: TEB=4096-position blocks, each block a TREE_W lane tree, block partials folded by a second lane tree in fixed ascending block order (segmented over every category of a column for te_enc); device part+fold kernels per fold, units and the host column (_mojolearn_x_prep_host) spell the same order. Replaces the lane-tree order (one group per unit over all n rows) for these two ops; the MOJOLEARN_IDN_TE_GLOBAL_TREE_OFF / _ENC_TREE_OFF defines are moot with it on. Bits: new fold order on NVIDIA, AMD and host together.

gmm_cov_sym.notes: per-component covariance as a two-block cover of the upper triangle (rows [0,h) x d, then (d-h)^2 block, h=d//2) with the shipped identical GEMM as the tile (3/4 of the cells), then cov_finish_sym mirrors cell (min,max) into both triangles. Upper-triangle words unchanged (GEMM contract: a cell depends on k and its operand words only); the lower triangle becomes the transposed upper words, on NVIDIA, AMD and the host (_mojolearn_mixture_host mirrors the same cell). Applies on the plain per-component path only: off for that fit when the paired center kernels (MOJOLEARN_IDN_GMM_CENTER_PAIR / C53) or a sabotage run.
